title: Disciplinary Incidents - February 2022
content:
Case ID: DA-2021-045
Employee: James Peterson
Infraction: Unauthorized disclosure of confidential project details to an external party.
Action Taken: Formal warning issued, mandatory confidentiality training, and a three-month performance review period implemented.

Case ID: DA-2021-052
Employee: Angela White
Infraction: Failure to comply with client confidentiality agreements by sharing sensitive client data with unauthorized internal staff.
Action Taken: Written reprimand, reassigned from the project, and placed under a six-month probationary surveillance for data handling practices.

Case ID: DA-2022-003
Employee: Marcus Lee
Infraction: Misuse of company resources for personal projects during office hours, leading to a significant decrease in productivity.
Action Taken: Verbal warning, restitution of misused resources, and a detailed review of company policies on resource usage.

Case ID: DA-2022-011
Employee: Sophia Rodriguez
Infraction: Breach of the company's social media policy by posting confidential information on a public forum.
Action Taken: Suspension without pay for two weeks, removal of the post, and completion of a digital responsibility workshop.

Case ID: DA-2022-027
Employee: Eric Johnson
Infraction: Neglecting to secure sensitive information on company devices, resulting in a data leak.
Action Taken: Termination of employment, legal action considered to recover damages, and an internal audit to prevent future breaches.
